directed.boundary_or_failure: The Euler product has its own domain of validity, while substituting □ into ζ requires a separate functional calculus and domain. Universality and adelic analogy do not prove physical naturalness, and the mass claim is explicitly RH-conditional.
directed.uncertainty: Low uncertainty about the reframing and conditionality; high uncertainty about operator meaning, normalization, and spectral interpretation.
